name: kmtank
description: KMTank - a diep.io-like realtime multiplayer tank arena with Google login and ranked tiers

scripts.build: npm run build -w @kmtank/shared && npm run build -w @kmtank/server && npm run build -w @kmtank/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @kmtank/server" "npm run dev -w @kmtank/client"
